text:
```yaml
name: SWE-Lancer Task Browser
on:
  push:
    paths:
      - 'repos/frontier-evals/project/swelancer/all_swelancer_tasks.csv'
      - 'scripts/build-swelancer-pages.ts'
      - 'package.json'
      - '.github/workflows/swelancer-pages.yml'
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  build-and-deploy:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          submodules: recursive

      - name: Setup Bun
        uses: oven-sh/setup-bun@v1

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: bun install

      - name: Build SWE-Lancer pages
        run: bun run build:swelancer-pages

      - name: Upload artifact
        uses: actions/upload-pages-artifact@v3
        with:
          path: docs/
          name: github-pages

      - name: Deploy to GitHub Pages
        id: deployment
        uses: actions/deploy-pages@v4
```
